tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run a JavaScript async-function body in a sandbox that calls tools synchronously; only console.log output and the return value come back. Use for batch work (loops, grep+aggregate, edits). Paths: relative to cwd. On big trees give glob/grep a path or specific pattern. Errors carry .code/.nextAction and "[CODE]" prefix: INVALID_ARGUMENT NOT_FOUND NOT_UNIQUE STALE EXISTS POLICY_DENIED BUSY OUTPUT_LIMIT RG_UNAVAILABLE RESULT_UNKNOWN. tools.read({path,offset?,limit?}). tools.write({path,content}); tools.edit({path,old,new,all?}) (atomic; edit checks STALE). tools.glob({pattern?:string|string[],path?,sort?:"path"|"modified",details?,offset?,limit?=5000}) and tools.grep({pattern,path?,glob?,ignoreCase?,outputMode?:"content"|"files_with_matches"|"count",before?,after?,multiline?,offset?=0,limit?=500}) -> {items,total,complete,nextOffset} (ripgrep: .gitignore honoured; skips hidden, node_modules, target, .venv, files>2MB). glob items: path, or {path,size,mtime} with details. grep items: {file,line,text<=300} (+uncounted context:true rows), {file,count}, or paths. tools.replace({pattern(JS regex; lookaround, \1, named groups ok),replacement($1 ok),path?,glob?,flags?,dryRun?,maxReplacements?}) -> {files,matches,changed,items:[{file,count}],dryRun}. tools.batch({action:"plan"|"run"|"resume"|"list",operations:[{op:"copy"|"move"|"remove",path,to?}],protect?:string[],root?,toRoot?,id?}): root-relative "/" paths (to is relative to toRoot if given: another dir/drive), <=512 ops, no overwrite, destination parent must exist, no links, protect untouched; preflighted first. plan only journals; run needs operations; resume takes only id (unknown items: checked, not redone); list shows jobs. -> {id,status:"completed"|"partial"|"failed"|"planned",done,failed,unknown,total,detailsRef}. tools.bash({command,cwd?,timeoutMs?})->{code,stdout,stderr}. await tools.parallel([{command,cwd?,timeoutMs?}],{concurrency?=4,<=16}) runs <=64 bash calls -> [{code,stdout,stderr,timedOut?}] in order. ref.put(v)->id; ref.page(id,{offset,limit,fields,equals,maxBytes=16384})->{total,offset,items,nextOffset,complete,omitted} (OUTPUT_LIMIT if one row exceeds maxBytes; also reads detailsRef); ref.release(id). Refs: per session, 24h. Output over ~6000 chars is saved as a ref and truncated.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
